title: 第19章 瓶颈第20章 龟缩功
lines: 药膳房外，刀光剑影。
而吴厚孤身一人，一夫当关。
皇宫里来了许多新人，新到他不认识，新到不认识他。
竟然对着吴厚出刀了。
还是个武夫。
看着冷冽刀身，吴厚哑然失笑，知道这都是闽侯迢的意思。
那个小崽子，仗着是宠妃内亲，最近比较跳，竟然跳到药膳房来立威。
这是想动司礼监了？
动其他，吴厚懒得管，但药膳房，不行！
吴厚袍袖轻甩，一股狂风平地而升，瞬间将十几个侍卫冲的七零八落，倒在地上爬不起来。
之后枯手一抓，无数破风声起，在场所有人的宫刀，齐齐飞向吴厚。
如破铜烂铁般，团城一个铁球，飘在半空。
吴厚冷冷扔下一个字，
小队首领确实不认识吴厚，更没听说过他年轻的事迹。
虽从衣袍看出是个总管太监，但手握统领谕令，又怎会放在眼里。
统领平时欺的就是太监，连带着众禁卫也瞧不上太监。
又不是没干过强抢太监的事，也没见司礼监怎么着，怎么今天就碰上硬茬了。
首领艰难起身，恶毒的看了吴厚一眼，便带人狼狈离开。
不是首领怂，实在是吴厚表现出的实力，让他生不出反抗之心。
虽然吴厚只表现出炼气境气势，那也是修士。
首领就算已经是巅峰武夫，那也……只是个武夫。
常人修炼，从炼精开始，过了炼精，步入炼气才算真正入门修仙。
而武夫，就是过不了炼精的那一撮匹夫。
由于不能炼精化气，便将积累的精力，引向四肢五体，用以增加气力筑固体魄。
勉强算是一种体修，又比不上以灵力重塑肉身的体修。
所以一个武夫的实力，只能对应最低级的炼精期。
武夫之上有煅体、淬身、超凡等境界。
所以武修不是没高境，也能走长远，但总比修仙矮一截。
禁卫当然也有高人，奈何高人当不上小队首领。
对这一群匹夫，吴厚看都懒得多看一眼，不等人离开，便回身关上院门。
禁卫统领的震怒？
在他眼中也不过是头大匹夫。
院外的事，吴谦根本不知道，专心将小翠送回住处。
小翠站在门口，对吴谦今晚所为，心中充满感激。
content_en:
Outside the medicinal kitchen, there were flashes of swords and shadows.
But Wu Hou was alone, with only one man in charge.
There were many new people in the palace, so new that he didn’t recognize them, and they were so new that they didn’t recognize him.
He actually used the knife on Wu Hou.
Still a warrior.
Looking at the cold blade, Wu Hou laughed dumbly, knowing that this was Min Hou Tuo's intention.
That little brat, taking advantage of the fact that he is the beloved concubine's brother-in-law, has been quite active recently and even jumped to the medicinal kitchen to establish his authority.
Do you want to disturb the Supervisor of Ceremonies?
Wu Hou couldn't be bothered with anything else, but not the medicinal food room!
Wu Hou flicked his robe sleeves, and a strong wind rose from the ground. In an instant, more than a dozen guards were thrown to pieces, and they fell to the ground unable to get up.
Afterwards, with a grab with his withered hand, countless winds sounded, and the palace knives of everyone present flew towards Wu Hou.
Like broken copper and iron, Tuancheng was an iron ball floating in the air.
Wu Hou coldly dropped a word,
"Get out!"
The leader of the team really didn't know Wu Hou, let alone heard of his young deeds.
Although he could tell from his robes that he was a eunuch in charge, he had the command of the commander in hand, so how could he take it lightly.
The commander usually bullies the eunuchs, and even the guards look down on the eunuchs.
It’s not like I’ve never robbed an eunuch before, and I haven’t seen what happened to the eunuch, so why did I encounter a tough problem today.
The leader stood up with difficulty, gave Wu Hou a vicious look, and then left in embarrassment.
It wasn't that the leader was cowardly, it was Wu Hou's strength that made him unable to resist.
Although Wu Hou only showed the aura of the Qi Refining Realm, he was also a monk.
Even if the leader is already a peak martial artist, he is still... just a martial artist.
Ordinary people's cultivation begins with refining the essence. After refining the essence and entering into the refining of the qi, one can truly start cultivating immortals.
As for the warriors, they are just the handful of men who can't get past the refinement process.
Since the energy cannot be refined and transformed, the accumulated energy is directed to the limbs and five bodies to increase the energy and build the body.
It can barely be regarded as a kind of physical cultivation, but it is not as good as the physical cultivation of reshaping the physical body with spiritual power.
Therefore, the strength of a martial artist can only correspond to the lowest level of refining.
Above the martial arts level, there are realms such as body tempering, body tempering, and transcendence.
Therefore, martial arts cultivators are not without high levels and can go a long way, but they are still lower than cultivating immortals.
Of course there are experts in the imperial guards, but experts cannot be the leader of the team.
Wu Hou didn't even bother to look at this group of men. He turned around and closed the courtyard door before anyone left.
The wrath of the Guard Commander?
In his eyes, he was just a big guy.
——————
Wu Qian didn't know anything about what happened outside the hospital, so he concentrated on sending Xiaocui back to his residence.
Xiaocui stood at the door, feeling grateful for what Wu Qian had done tonight.
